pairings.title: Sound Bath + Breathwork
pairings.text: Breathwork clears and activates energy so the body can more deeply receive the healing frequencies of sound. Our sound and breath session brings both together.

pairings.title: Stretch & Yoga + The Labyrinth
pairings.text: Stretching prepares the body and opens awareness. Walking the labyrinth afterward deepens the meditation, turning movement into pilgrimage.

pairings.title: Lymphatic Massage + Sound Bath
pairings.text: The massage clears stagnant energy, preparing the body for vibrational alignment through sound.

pairings.title: Breathwork + Lymphatic Massage
pairings.text: Breathwork releases stored emotion while lymphatic massage flushes physical stagnation, for lightness and clarity.

pairings.title: All five together
pairings.text: Stretch opens the body, breath clears inner pathways, the labyrinth guides the soul's journey, massage purifies, and sound seals the process.
